subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Flexionar, adequadamente, na escrita e na oralidade, os verbos em concordância com pronomes pessoais/nomes sujeitos da oração.

components.description_pt: Conjugar verbos corretamente para concordar com sujeitos pronomes pessoais em contextos escritos
components.description_en: Inflect verbs correctly to agree with personal pronoun subjects in written contexts
components.cc_component_description: Use personal pronouns correctly as subjects and objects in sentences

components.description_pt: Aplicar concordância verbo-nominal correta com pronomes pessoais e sujeitos nominais em contextos orais
components.description_en: Apply correct subject-verb agreement with personal pronouns and noun subjects in oral contexts
components.cc_component_description: Use correct noun and verb agreement in written and spoken sentences

cc_matches.description: Use personal, possessive, and indefinite pronouns (e.g., I, me, my; they, them, their; anyone, everything).
Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English grammar and usage when writing or speaking.
